name: industrial-protocols
title: PHP 工业通信协议集
tagline: 39 个协议包共享一颗微内核
description: 面向 PHP 的工业通信协议集，采用微内核加协议 SDK 架构，覆盖 39 个协议包与 7 种运行时，内置连接管理、网关引擎、熔断、重试、Prometheus 指标与安全策略。

hero.sub: 协议包按需安装，连接管理、健康检查与网关规则由内核统一接管。

about.heading: 内核只定义协议是什么
body: 内核不含具体协议实现，只提供 ProtocolRegistry、ConnectionManager 与六个核心接口。协议包通过 extra 字段自动发现并注册。
连接管理提供三种策略，网关引擎、断路器、四种重试、Prometheus 指标、PSR-14 事件与 PSR-3 日志都在内核统一处理。
points: 微内核与协议 SDK 分离

features.heading: 协议之外，内核兜底
features.sub: 发现、连接、网关、重试、指标与安全，六件事一次配好。

items.title: 微内核发现
items.body: composer extra 自动发现协议包，启动时注册进 ProtocolRegistry。

items.title: 连接管理
items.body: 三种连接策略统一管理设备连接，健康检查给出状态与延迟。

items.title: 网关引擎
items.body: 在网关层编排跨协议读写规则，业务不必直连每台设备。

items.title: 熔断与重试

items.title: Prometheus
items.body: 连接、请求与错误指标可直接暴露给 Prometheus 抓取。

items.title: 七种运行时
items.body: 六框架加原生 PHP，共用一套 Kernel 与连接管理。

en.description: A PHP industrial communication protocol suite built on a micro-kernel and protocol SDK, with 39 protocol packages, seven runtimes, connection management, a gateway engine, circuit breaking, retries, Prometheus metrics and security policies.

hero.sub: Install protocol packages on demand while the kernel handles connections, health checks and gateway rules.

about.heading: Kernel defines a protocol
body: The kernel contains no protocol implementations; it provides ProtocolRegistry, ConnectionManager and six core interfaces, while packages are discovered and registered through the extra field.
Connection management offers three strategies; the gateway engine, circuit breaker, four retry policies, Prometheus metrics, PSR-14 events and PSR-3 logging are all handled by the kernel.

items.title: Micro-kernel discovery
items.body: Composer extra discovers protocol packages and registers them in ProtocolRegistry at boot.

items.title: Connection management
items.body: Three connection strategies manage device links, with health checks returning state and latency.

items.title: Gateway engine
items.body: Orchestrate cross-protocol read and write rules so business code need not reach every device.

items.title: Circuit breaker and retries
items.body: Four retry policies plus a circuit breaker keep a failing device from taking down the chain.

items.title: Prometheus
items.body: Connection, request and error metrics are exposed for Prometheus to scrape.

items.title: Seven runtimes
items.body: Six frameworks plus plain PHP share one Kernel and connection manager.

ports.heading: Same capability, Rust and Go
ports.sub: Beyond PHP, separate Rust and Go implementations cover their own protocol sets.

items.description: Rust micro-kernel and SDK covering 38 protocols, with 45 crates pulled in on demand.

docs.heading: 安装与使用
docs.sub: 先安装内核与协议包，再读一个设备寄存器。

tabs.label: PHP
Rust
Go
tabs.usage:
import (
    "github.com/erikwang2013/industrial-protocols-go/kernel"
    "github.com/erikwang2013/industrial-protocols-go/kernel/transport"
    "github.com/erikwang2013/industrial-protocols-go/protocols/ethernet/modbus"
)

tr, _ := transport.DialTCP("192.168.1.10:502")
defer tr.Close()

codec, _ := modbus.NewCodec("tcp")
req := &kernel.Request{Function: "read_holding_registers", Address: "40001", Count: 2}
req.Metadata["unit_id"] = byte(1)

raw, _ := codec.Encode(req)
tr.Write(raw)
buf := make([]byte, 256)
n, _ := tr.Read(buf)
resp, _ := codec.Decode(buf[:n])
_ = resp
